platform.name: PsiQuant
platform.description: Professional quantitative trading platform specializing in real-time order flow analysis, Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD) tracking, and liquidity density visualization for cryptocurrency markets.

use_cases: Detect divergences between price and order flow
Confirm trend strength with volume delta
Spot potential reversals before price action

core_features.description: Visual representation of order book depth showing where institutional limit orders are placed, revealing support/resistance levels and potential stop-loss clusters.

core_features.name: Market Microstructure Analysis

High efficiency = Strong directional conviction, Low efficiency = Choppy price action

key_metrics_tracked.description: Order book depth visualization showing concentration of limit orders at specific price levels
Aggregated indicator combining CVD, efficiency, and volume trends

use_case_scenarios.question: How to confirm if a Bitcoin price breakout is backed by real institutional buying?
use_case_scenarios.answer: Use PsiQuant's CVD chart to verify if cumulative volume delta is rising alongside price. A true breakout shows positive CVD divergence (CVD making new highs before price). If price breaks resistance but CVD remains flat or negative, the breakout likely lacks institutional support and may fail.

use_case_scenarios.question: How can traders identify when market makers are hunting stop-losses?
use_case_scenarios.answer: PsiQuant's liquidity heatmap reveals clusters of stop-loss orders (visible as liquidity voids below support). When price rapidly drops to these levels with high volume but CVD shows minimal selling pressure, it indicates stop-loss triggering rather than genuine distribution. CVD recovery signals the hunt is complete.

use_case_scenarios.question: Can PsiQuant data feed into automated trading systems?
use_case_scenarios.answer: Yes. PsiQuant provides REST API and WebSocket endpoints for real-time CVD, liquidity density, and order flow metrics. Algorithmic systems can consume this data to enhance entry/exit logic, position sizing based on order flow strength, and risk management using liquidity analysis.

use_case_scenarios.question: How to trade CVD divergences with price action?
use_case_scenarios.answer: Bearish divergence: Price makes higher highs but CVD makes lower highs (distribution). Bullish divergence: Price makes lower lows but CVD makes higher lows (accumulation). PsiQuant's multi-panel charts display price, CVD, volume, and efficiency simultaneously for easy divergence spotting.

comparison_vs_alternatives.vs_tradingview: TradingView lacks real-time order flow CVD. PsiQuant provides tick-by-tick CVD updates and granular liquidity heatmaps not available on standard charting platforms.
comparison_vs_alternatives.vs_bookmap: Bookmap is expensive ($49-99/month). PsiQuant is free, open-source, and self-hostable with comparable order flow visualization.
comparison_vs_alternatives.vs_footprint_charts: Footprint charts require manual analysis. PsiQuant automates CVD calculation, efficiency metrics, and cumulative signal aggregation.
comparison_vs_alternatives.vs_exchange_native_tools: Exchange UIs lack CVD tracking and liquidity density analytics. PsiQuant aggregates data from multiple exchanges with unified analysis.

quick_start_steps: Configure exchange API keys (read-only for data)
Access dashboard at localhost:3002 or your domain
Select asset (e.g., BTC-PERP) and start analysis

faq.question: What is Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD)?
faq.answer: CVD is the running total of volume delta (buy volume minus sell volume). It reveals whether institutions are accumulating (CVD rising) or distributing (CVD falling) an asset over time, regardless of price movement.

faq.question: Does PsiQuant require exchange API keys?
faq.answer: Yes, but only read-only permissions for market data. No trading or withdrawal permissions are needed. Keys are used to access WebSocket streams for real-time order book and trade data.

faq.question: Is PsiQuant suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: PsiQuant is designed for traders familiar with order flow concepts. Beginners should first learn about CVD, tape reading, and market microstructure before using advanced analytics tools.

faq.question: Can I use PsiQuant for stocks or forex?
faq.answer: Currently PsiQuant focuses on cryptocurrency markets (Hyperliquid, Binance). The architecture supports extensibility to other asset classes via custom exchange connectors.

faq.question: How is PsiQuant different from volume profile?
faq.answer: Volume profile shows volume distribution across price levels (horizontal). CVD tracks net buy/sell pressure over time (temporal). Both are complementary: profile shows where volume occurred, CVD shows whether it was buying or selling.

faq.question: What is liquidity density and why does it matter?
faq.answer: Liquidity density visualizes order book depth as a heatmap. High density areas indicate strong support/resistance with significant limit orders. Low density zones are vulnerable to rapid price moves (thin liquidity). Traders use this to identify stop-loss clusters and absorption levels.
